body:
Could you provide a simple reproducer?

The current behavior is kind of expected, as @Blocking works with Mutiny. However, we can probably improve.
MY bad, you kind of provided a reproducer - having a look.

Hum, it seems to work fine for me. 

Can you provide a reproducer that demonstrates the issue?

@cescoffier provided a full example. I didn't know how to switch implementations of the non working and working class so I commented some code for the working example as explained in readme.

https://github.com/Schallabajzr/quarkus_blocking_bug_example

Thanks @Schallabajzr.

However, the reproducer works for me. I switched to the non-mutiny implementation and got the correct results (no exception). I checked on which thread the gRPC service was called, and, as expected, I'm on a worker thread.
ah! Got it! It's the mutiny variant that is problematic.
@cescoffier yes Mutiny version fails, sorry if it was unclear. Were you able to reproduce it?
@Schallabajzr Yes! I even have a fix. Polishing it right now. Expect a PR in a few hours.
